### Bug fixes
- Fix scroll element block (https://github.com/AutomaApp/automa/commit/8955de573e22d201f48077627ac6d428d0bd1c3d), close #1507

comments.body:
My workflow keeps running repeatedly while it should be once per day (by checking variables in workflow). Then I found in Storage tab, the variables are prefixed with duplicated "$$". So, I guess this is the cause.

In previous code, the variable's name was sliced: https://github.com/AutomaApp/automa/pull/1522/files#diff-e2be43c3a6d1b35564d0d2980d83866ffef90cca2e66eded0a5ac7b47db31a08L509
You're right, will fix in the next update
